SELECT Sum((bd.I_price*Bill_rate)*(bd.i_qty+bd.sub_qty/i_size)) AS TotSalePrice, Sum((bd.i_qty+bd.sub_qty/i_size)) AS TotSaleQty, Sum((c_price*stock_rate)*(bd.i_qty+bd.sub_qty/i_size)) AS TotSaleCost, (TotSalePrice-TotSaleCost) AS NetProfit
FROM ((bills AS B INNER JOIN bill_detail AS BD ON (B.Bill_Type = BD.Bill_type) AND (B.Bill_no = BD.Bill_no)) INNER JOIN Sale_Cost ON (BD.I_code = Sale_Cost.I_code) AND (BD.Bill_no = Sale_Cost.Bill_No) AND (BD.Bill_type = Sale_Cost.Bill_Type)) INNER JOIN item_detail ON BD.I_code = item_detail.i_code;

FROM gr_detail, item_detail
WHERE item_detail.i_code=gr_detail.i_code and (c_qty >0 or sc_qty >0)

Views.CommandText:
SELECT rbd.i_code, Sum(RBD.I_qty+RBD.si_qty/i_size) AS TotRtSale, Sum((rt_rate*i_rate)*RBD.I_qty+RBD.si_qty/i_size) AS TotRtSalePrice, (TotRtSalePrice/TotRtSale) AS UnitAvgPrice, Sum((S.cost_rate*c_Price)*RBD.I_qty+RBD.si_qty/i_size) AS TotRtSaleCost
FROM ((RT_BILLS AS RB INNER JOIN rt_Bill_detail AS rbd ON (RB.rt_bill_type = rbd.Rt_Bill_type) AND (RB.rt_bill_no = rbd.Rt_Bill_No)) LEFT JOIN item_detail AS ID ON rbd.i_code = ID.i_code) INNER JOIN Sale_Cost AS S ON (rbd.i_code = S.I_code) AND (rbd.Rt_Bill_No = S.Bill_No) AND (rbd.Rt_Bill_type = S.Bill_Type)
WHERE (((RB.rt_bill_date)>=DateValue('01/01/12') And (RB.rt_bill_date)<=DateValue('31/12/12')) AND ((rbd.i_code)>='' And (rbd.i_code)<='') AND ((RB.rtn_a_code)>='0' And (RB.rtn_a_code)<='99999999'))
GROUP BY rbd.i_code;
Views.Name: ReturnQty

Views.CommandText:
SELECT sale_cost.i_code, sum((i_qty+(si_qty/iif(not isnull(i_size),i_size,1)))*c_price) AS sl_cst, sum(i_qty+(si_qty/iif(not isnull(i_size),i_size,1))) AS sl_qty
FROM sale_cost, item_detail
WHERE item_detail.i_code = sale_cost.i_code And Bill_Type = 1
GROUP BY sale_cost.i_code;
Views.Name: sl_qry

Views.CommandText:
SELECT BD.I_code, Sum(BD.I_qty+BD.sub_qty/i_size) AS TotSale, Sum((Bill_rate*I_price)*BD.I_qty+BD.sub_qty/i_size) AS TotSalePrice, (TotSalePrice/TotSale) AS UnitAvgPrice, Sum((stock_rate*c_price)*BD.I_qty+BD.sub_qty/i_size) AS TotSaleCost
FROM ((Bills AS B INNER JOIN Bill_detail AS BD ON (B.Bill_no = BD.Bill_no) AND (B.Bill_Type = BD.Bill_type)) LEFT JOIN item_detail AS ID ON BD.I_code = ID.i_code) INNER JOIN Sale_Cost AS S ON (BD.I_code = S.I_code) AND (BD.Bill_no = S.Bill_No) AND (BD.Bill_type = S.Bill_Type)
WHERE (((B.Bill_date)>=DateValue('01/01/12') And (B.Bill_date)<=DateValue('31/12/12')) AND ((BD.I_code)>='' And (BD.I_code)<='') AND ((B.c_v_code)>='0' And (B.c_v_code)<='99999999'))
GROUP BY BD.I_code;
Views.Name: SoldQty

Views.CommandText:
SELECT sale_cost.i_code, sum((i_qty+(si_qty/iif(not isnull(i_size),i_size,1)))*c_price) AS sr_cst, sum(i_qty+(si_qty/iif(not isnull(i_size),i_size,1))) AS sr_qty
FROM sale_cost, item_detail
WHERE item_detail.i_code = sale_cost.i_code And Bill_Type = 3
GROUP BY sale_cost.i_code;
Views.Name: sr_qry

Views.CommandText:
SELECT sum(item_store.avail_qty) AS av_qty, sum(open_stock) AS op_qty, sum(sub_av_qty) AS sb_av_qty, sum(sub_op_stk) AS sb_op_qty, item_store.i_code, item_detail.i_cost, item_detail.g_code, item_detail.i_cwtavg, item_detail.i_a_name, item_detail.i_measure, item_detail.i_cur_cost
FROM item_store, item_detail
WHERE item_store.i_code = item_detail.i_code
GROUP BY item_store.i_code, item_detail.i_cost, item_detail.g_code, item_detail.i_a_name, item_detail.i_cwtavg, item_detail.i_measure, item_detail.i_cur_cost
ORDER BY i_a_name;

SELECT income_qry.i_code, iif(not isnull(sl_cst),(in_cst-sl_cst),in_cst) AS t1_cst, iif(not isnull(sl_qty),(in_qty-sl_qty) ,in_qty) AS t1_qty
